title: It's a Serious Game!
overview: Haru, Sachiko, Sae, Minami, the Producer and Yuki play a game of baseball and soccer mixed together.

title: !. or !? / The Power of Idols / Like a Cherry?
overview: Atsumi, banned from groping other idols in their breasts, attempts to grope Chihiro. Anzu and Hina watch both Rika and Hiromi play in the river. Miho brings a bowl of cherries to share with Kyoko and Uzuki, only to find out that her head, thanks to her green hair antenna, resembles a cherry.

title: Win-Win/ Exciting Amusement Park / I Didn't Throw It Away, Right?:
overview: Yuuki takes pictures with the amusement park's bear mascot. Sachiko gets splashed with water. Shin rides a rollercoaster.

title: Heated Warm Up! / It's a Special Training / Bling Bling. Cleaning the Pool
overview: Mio, Akane and Aiko warm up beside the swimming pool. Akane gets everyone to practice swimming, but Syuko ends up relaxing in a small plastic swimming pool. Syoko cleans the pool.

title: Yoshino Shubababa / Smell of the Ocean / I'm an Idol
overview: Yoshino splashes Mirei and Haruna with water in the beach. Shiki, Fumika and Mika enjoy the smell of the ocean. Tomoe encounters Mizuki sitting on the beach sand.

title: Even If I'm the Audience! / This Makes Me Happy in Its Own Way! / The Result of Lessons
overview: Ryo wants to head to a music festival. Rina spots herself in a picture on a music magazine, despite the fact that she only appears there as an audience member. Taking a break from lessons, Kaede goes to a German rock music festival.

title: Welcome to Oikawa Ranch
overview: Kaoru and Arisu visit Shizuku's family milk ranch.

title: The Summer's Night Sky and the Maiden's Cry / The Summer's Night Sky and the Maiden's Scream / Wishing Upon the Summer's Night Sky
overview: Rin and Nao take Karen to a summer festival for the first time. Momoka lights fireworks the with the Producer. Tamami, Hiromi, Fumika and Miria scream out their names while the fireworks explode in the night sky.

title: I Do Like Dirt, After All / Girly Today / Wish Fulfilled Just a Bit
overview: Hajime accidentally covers herself with mud. Yui blows bubbles and Kanade notices. Miyu watches the night sky and eventually falls asleep.
